pool.title: Find in my pool
pool.intro: Looks through the candidates you already have for people who resemble this position's confirmed success profile. These are suggestions for you to look at: nobody is added to the position until you add them, and the similarity figure is only a reference.

basis.keyword: Compared by keywords, because the meaning search is not available right now.

pool.coverage: {poolSize, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}} in your pool. {notIndexed, plural, =0 {All are indexed.} one {# is not indexed yet and was not compared.} other {# are not indexed yet and were not compared.}}
pool.alreadyIn: {count, plural, one {# candidate is already in this position and is not listed.} other {# candidates are already in this position and are not listed.}}
pool.none: Nobody in your pool resembles this profile yet.
pool.suggestion: This list is a suggestion. The order and the figures are a reference, not a ranking of who is better.

errors.notConfirmed: Confirm the success profile first: the search starts from the confirmed version.
errors.budget: This month's AI budget has been used. Ask your admin to raise it.
errors.generic: Could not search the pool. Try again.

portfolio.title: Open positions
portfolio.intro: Shows how this candidate could fit the open positions of your agency. It is a suggestion for you to review; nothing is changed.

why.no_answer: The assistant gave no answer for it

portfolio.truncated: There are more open positions than one check covers. The most recent ones were checked.

errors.noProfile: This candidate has no confirmed profile yet.
errors.noPositions: There is no open position with a confirmed success profile to compare with.
errors.budget: This month's AI budget has been used. Ask your admin to raise it.
errors.generic: Could not check the open positions. Try again.

benchmark.title: Market benchmark
benchmark.intro: Compares this position with similar ones: first your own earlier positions, then public web pages. Everything here is a draft until you approve it, and no suggested change reaches the job description until you accept it.
benchmark.webOn: Web search is on. Only free public pages are used, and each finding shows its source and date.
benchmark.webOff: Web search is not switched on on this server, so the benchmark uses your own data only.
benchmark.webNoResults: The web search found nothing that could be cited.
benchmark.dropped: {count, plural, one {# web finding was left out because no cited page backs it.} other {# web findings were left out because no cited page backs them.}}

ourData.heading: Our data
ourData.hint: Counted from your agency's own earlier positions with similar titles. Each line links to those positions.
ourData.empty: No earlier position with a similar title.

web.heading: Web
web.hint: Public web pages only. No paid sources.

suggestions.heading: Suggested changes to the job description
suggestions.hint: Accept or reject each one. An accepted change goes into a new draft of the structured job description, which you still approve there.
suggestions.needsApproval: Approve the report above to accept or reject these.
suggestions.noJd: Structure the job description first: there is nothing to change yet.

errors.conflict: This could not be applied. Check the structured job description.
errors.generic: Could not save that. Try again.

errors.webSearch: Web search is not available. An owner has to switch it on for the Anthropic account.
errors.budget: This month's AI budget has been used. Ask your admin to raise it.
errors.generic: Could not run the benchmark. Try again.
